title: llmsa 0.1.0
text: First public release. Crossed study design (msa_design()), execution audit trail resumable store (msa_run()), import external results (as_msa_runs()). Backends: backend_mock(), backend_ellmer(), backend_openai_compatible(); parsers numbers, labels JSON fields. Variance components numeric, ordinal binary outcomes (msa_fit()), gauge R&R statistics AIAG classification (msa_grr()), parametric bootstrap intervals (msa_boot()). Attribute agreement Krippendorff’s alpha Cohen’s kappa (msa_agreement()), bias linearity (msa_bias()). Plackett-Burman robustness screening Lenth’s method (pb_design(), msa_robustness()). Simulation-based study planning (msa_simulate(), msa_plan()). Westgard-rule control charts system suitability (msa_control_chart()). Validation report template (msa_report()). Simulated demonstration data acmg_demo ic50_demo. Known limitations: bootstrap ordinal fits; batched multi-item prompts (position carry-effects) free-text outcomes judged second model planned later release.
